render_execution_device: physical Panther Lake NPU on Delta
findings: All 25 received frames were received while the indirect display was the sole confirmed guest path. A complete desktop, Run dialog and complete Notepad UI were visually inspected.

Typed text is visible in the Notepad tab title and the status column advances, but text is absent from the editor. The typing gate is deliberately not advanced; maximize and close are not attempted on the NPU path.

The active Notepad process repeatedly rejects a captured 146-word pixel shader. Its unsigned right shift and bitwise OR instructions were unsupported. The original binary is retained privately by hash; source code was not recovered.
The same owned text appears in the editor after restoring the ordinary guest display. Keyboard delivery succeeded; the observed defect is in rendering.

The corrected 1800-second relay stays active for the entire controlled test. There is no logged NPU device-loss or queue-creation failure. Worker exit 1 reports the socket closing during controller cleanup and is preserved.

The controller requests cancellation after preserving evidence. The monotonic v33 topology helper records restoration before guest driver removal; the observer wait is 2090 milliseconds. Both owned devices are removed, input permission is revoked, and the ordinary desktop is visually verified.
The full 971-request ordered prefix and all 39 guest archive members are verified by length and SHA256. Raw frames, shader and request payloads remain in ignored/private evidence.

Interaction remains slow: Run arrives about 118 seconds after input and the complete Notepad UI about 193 seconds after launch. Full desktop offload, practical interaction, physical display migration and a Tahoma benefit remain unfinished.
